compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Read-only static ELF kernel declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: Native zero-C WMMA supplies the unchanged16 approximate K16 partials per score. Each fused thread owns one score and reads partials in the original ascending FP32 prefix order. Four or16 exact integer alignment plans are prepared before their ordered carry validation, using fixed-size local arrays with constant indices. Every actual alignment exponent must match before a plan is accepted; any mismatch or unsupported input recomputes the complete original dot. The fused kernels have no global-plan pointer and do not launch a separate completion kernel. Compiled resource declarations report whether the compiler retained local arrays without private storage. The original current control and both global-plan layouts remain in the same fixture. All plan variants must report identical accepted-plan and fallback totals. No native estimate computes accepted output bits, no new arithmetic error bound is assumed, and product dispatch remains unchanged.
correctness_scope: Host ASan/UBSan checks8192 generated sequences and131072 original carry boundaries, with seven exact, approximate, incorrect and invalid guesses per group; rejected outputs remain unchanged, and valid scalar-float plans match the independent packed-integer plans. Native generated and captured outputs are checked bit-for-bit against original canonical GPU scores, including masked scores, guards and unused tails, alongside independent wide CPU dot checks. Every captured attempt also checks plan controls, plan guards and unused storage, and separately reruns audited completion to check output parity. Audit counters report only the final attempt per variant/slab and measure accepted plans before any full-score fallback. The q8192 component repeats the first1023 captured rows and is not a new real-model prompt. Original operands, prepared metadata and input encodings remain immutable. Oracle/reference data do not compute or select candidate work.
timing_scope: One warmup and three completed measurements per slab, with five-variant order rotated across slabs. Timers include native partials, all plan preparation, exact ordered completion and complete original fallback. The same Q/K preparation is added once to every arm. All variants allocate the same maximum plan arena,2GiB at q8192 batch128, but every byte must remain untouched in the current and fused variants; only the two global-plan layouts use it. Allocation, reset, transfers, audit counting and verification are outside clocks. Every captured attempt checks outputs, guards and unused storage; separate audited execution checks output parity and records accepted/fallback totals after the final attempt. This is an isolated QK component experiment, excluding probability/PV, model load, TTFT and generation.

decision.decision: Keep both fused exact-plan kernels isolated. All five variants match every original raw score on all attempts, and all four plan variants have identical accepted/fallback totals. Fused4/16 windows reduce complete q8192 QK to580.5647/666.1489ms versus952.8834ms transposed global plans, but both regress against337.1144ms selected prepared QK. The fused kernels have no global-plan pointer, their allocated comparison arena remains untouched, and static ELF declarations report zero private segment and130VGPRs with32768-byte normal LDS. Those declarations are not measured occupancy or limiting-resource evidence.
